svg.title: Building a PRD with taskgraph go
svg.desc: Running taskgraph go on a PRD: it plans four tasks, then Claude Code builds and commits each one in its own session until all tasks are complete.

g.text: Or hand it the whole PRD
Scaffold project and wire CLI entry point end-to-end
Implement CLI argument and stdin handling
Finalize test suite and npm test script
· default preset · up to 4 iterations · Claude CLI
Starts with task 1 Scaffold project and wire CLI entry point end-to-end
Task 2 is done: `slugify` now lowercases, strips accents, collapses runs of
non-alphanumerics into one hyphen and trims the ends.
Task 3 is done and committed: `bin/slugify.js` now slugifies each argument, or
each non-empty stdin line when there are no arguments, printing one slug per
Task 4 is done: `npm test` now runs `node --test` and all 5 tests pass.
